items.hed: Texans are on the road Sunday at Tennessee, noon Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans site lists Sunday’s Week 4 game against Dallas as played at Reliant Stadium. It does not print a final score on the schedule page. Next up is Sunday, Oct. 11, at the Titans in Nashville, noon Central, on CBS. The club’s London game at Jacksonville is the week after, Oct. 18.

items.hed: Astros open the offseason hunting a general manager, with Espada in his last contract year
items.insight: MLB.com reported that Houston, swept by the White Sox in the American League Wild Card Series, will search for a new general manager and maybe a new manager. Joe Espada, in the last year of his contract, said Wednesday he would like to return. The club reached the postseason for the ninth time in 10 years at 81-81, used a club-record 19 starting pitchers, and led the American League with 650 walks.

items.hed: Rockets open the preseason Friday against Dallas in Macao
items.insight: The NBA’s season-dates release lists Houston and Dallas for preseason games at The Venetian Arena in Macao on Oct. 9 and Oct. 11. Rosters for opening day are set Oct. 19. The regular season starts Oct. 20.
